title: get_history_data needs a date window
summary: get_history_data requires at least one of start or end; rows alone is not enough.
narrative: get_history_data requires at least one of start or end. Passing only rows raises: at least one of start or end should be given. For 'last six months' screens, resolve the latest local trading day first, then compute lookback.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
# Need a date window — rows alone is not enough:
data = qt.get_history_data('close', shares='000300.SH', start='20240101', end='20241231')
print(data.shape)
